## v0.5.7 · DSH 0.1.5 Compatibility and Document Archival

v0.5.7 fixes Memory system HTTP 405 errors on the published DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 profile and makes document archival validate its destination before writing an index.

- Restore authenticated Settings, Status and Source RPC routes on DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 while retaining earlier supported DSH peer ranges.
- Emit valid Session metadata and ship `dsh-mnemon-repair-session` for explicit preview or copy repair of the two known legacy Mnemon summary fields. Existing Sessions are not modified automatically. Stop DSH, back up the complete Session root and follow the [recovery procedure](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.7/docs/en/guides/operations.md#dsh-015-compatibility-and-legacy-session-recovery) before replacing a file.
- Build archive lineage from Host-owned durable receipts, reuse exact indexes and compensate new indexes if the document commit fails. Invalid plans create no index, and live read-only policy is respected.

Implementation: [#226](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/226), [#224](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/224).

### Packages and upgrade

The Starter advances to **0.5.7**. Runtime, Documents and Memory Spaces Sources advance to **0.5.6**. Mnemon Native Provider and Default Three-tier Strategy remain at **0.5.5**; the other eleven plugins remain at **0.5.4**.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.7
```

Restart DSH and reload the browser; use `headless` for that Profile. The full DSH profile requires Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`. Memory storage formats remain unchanged. Keep pre-migration Session backups if you may return to an older DSH version.

The release workflow freezes and verifies four changed artifacts, reads back and installs the complete npm composition, and tests a Registry upgrade from v0.4.7 before creating this release.

### 中文说明

本版修复 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 下记忆系统设置与状态的 HTTP 405，纠正新会话消息元数据，并提供旧会话的显式副本修复命令。修复前需停止 DSH、备份整个会话根目录，按[恢复流程](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.7/docs/zh-CN/guides/operations.md#dsh-015-兼容与旧会话恢复)验证副本；不会自动改写已有会话。

文档归档改为 Host 验证目标、写入索引并生成回执；无效提案不产生孤立索引，提交失败时补偿清理，并遵循实时只读策略。主包发布 0.5.7，三个 Source 发布 0.5.6，其余插件保持原版本。

See the [English release notes](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.7/docs/en/releases/v0.5.7.md), [中文发布说明](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.7/docs/zh-CN/releases/v0.5.7.md), [DSH compatibility evidence](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.7/docs/pr-assets/issue-223-dsh-015/README.md) and [document archival evidence](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.7/docs/pr-assets/issue-222-document-archive/README.md). Historical screenshots retain their tested revisions; loopback fixtures do not establish live-model quality.
